en.title: China ski resorts snow forecast, 28 November - 4 December: snow for the Altay, a dry week for Chongli
en.description: Koktokay could get about 13 cm, Hemu and Jiangjunshan about 8 cm by 4 December; Chongli, Yanqing and the Jilin resorts stay dry.
en.lede: The next week will widen the gap between China's two ski regions. The forecast brings new snow to the Altay in northern Xinjiang, with about 13 cm at the top of Koktokay and about 8 cm at Hemu and Jiangjunshan between 28 November and 4 December 2026. Around Chongli and Beijing it stays dry and cold, which is bad news for natural snow but good news for snowmaking.

p: For 14 of the best-known ski areas we took an ensemble of weather forecasts for the height of each top lift and added up the new snow from 28 November to 4 December. We give the middle forecast, and the lowest and highest ones to show how sure it is. When the three are close, the forecast is solid; when they are far apart, treat the middle number as a rough guide.

sections.h: Xinjiang: more snow for the Altay
p: Koktokay, the highest ski area on our list with its top at 3,077 m, gets the most: about 13 cm in the middle forecast, between 2 and 18 cm. Hemu, which already has the deepest natural snow in China, could add about 8 cm, between 1 and 11 cm. Jiangjunshan, above Altay city, could also get about 8 cm, between 1 and 10 cm.

In the Tianshan, Sayram Lake could get about 6 cm at its top lift, while the Silk Road ski area near Urumqi gets only about 1 cm. It will be very cold up high: the coldest forecast night at the top of Koktokay and Hemu reaches about -30 °C, so the new snow will be light and dry.

sections.h: Chongli and Beijing: dry and cold
p: For Wanlong, Genting, Thaiwoo, Fulong and the Yanqing alpine centre the middle forecast is 0 cm for the whole week, and even the highest forecast shows no new snow. Nights at the top lifts fall to about -15 °C at Wanlong, Genting, Thaiwoo and Yanqing, and about -13 °C at Fulong.
For skiers this is not a bad week. Cold, dry nights are exactly what snowmaking needs, and the big Chongli resorts can open more runs on machine snow. Just do not expect powder here before December.

sections.h: Jilin and Heilongjiang: a little snow at Yabuli
p: In the north-east, Yabuli Sun Mountain is the only ski area on our list with a real chance of snow: about 4 cm, between 0 and 7 cm. Changbaishan could get about 1 cm. Beidahu and Songhua Lake near Jilin city stay dry in the middle forecast, with at most 1 cm at Beidahu in the highest one. The coldest nights reach about -18 °C at the top of Beidahu and -16 °C at Yabuli Sun Mountain.

sections.h: Why the two regions are so different
p: Northern Xinjiang and the north-east of China share the same latitude, but not the same weather. The Altay and the Tianshan catch the moist westerly air that crosses Central Asia, and in late autumn that air often brings light snow to the mountains, which the deep cold then keeps. The north-east sits under the dry winter monsoon: cold air comes down from Mongolia and Siberia, the sky is clear for days, and real snow needs a storm from the south or the sea.

That is why Chongli can be very cold and still bare, and why its ski areas invest so much in snowmaking. It is also why a single storm can change the picture there quickly: when one comes, it is worth watching the map.

sections.h: What it means for a trip
p: If you want natural snow in the first days of December, the Altay is the safe choice: Hemu and Koktokay already have the deepest base in the country, and the week adds to it. If you ski near Beijing, plan for groomed machine-snow runs and pick a cold weekday to avoid the queues. We will follow the snow every day on the map and in new posts, in English and in Chinese.

advice: Altay (Hemu, Koktokay, Jiangjunshan): the best bet for natural snow in early December.
Chongli and Yanqing: dry week, skiing on machine snow; check the open runs before you go.
At about -30 °C at the top, frostbite comes fast: cover your face and take breaks indoors.
Forecasts a week ahead can still change: check again the evening before you travel.

zh.title: 中国滑雪场降雪预报（11月28日至12月4日）：阿勒泰迎来新雪，崇礼一周干燥
zh.description: 到12月4日，可可托海可能下约 13 厘米，禾木和将军山约 8 厘米；崇礼、延庆和吉林的雪场保持干燥。
zh.lede: 未来一周，中国两大滑雪区的差距将进一步拉大。预报显示，2026年11月28日至12月4日，新疆北部的阿勒泰将迎来新雪：可可托海山顶约 13 厘米，禾木和将军山约 8 厘米。崇礼和北京一带则保持干冷，这对天然雪是坏消息，对造雪却是好消息。

p: 我们为 14 家最知名的滑雪场取了各自山顶缆车高度的集合天气预报，把11月28日至12月4日的新雪加起来。我们给出中间值，以及最低和最高的预报，来说明预报有多可靠。三者接近时，预报比较稳定；相差很大时，中间值只能作为大致参考。
可可托海是我们名单上海拔最高的滑雪场，顶部 3,077 米，降雪也最多：中间预报约 13 厘米，范围在 2 到 18 厘米之间。已经拥有全国最厚天然积雪的禾木可能再增加约 8 厘米，范围 1 到 11 厘米。阿勒泰市旁边的将军山同样可能下约 8 厘米，范围 1 到 10 厘米。
天山方面，赛里木湖滑雪场山顶缆车处可能下约 6 厘米，而乌鲁木齐附近的丝绸之路滑雪场只有约 1 厘米。高处会非常寒冷：可可托海和禾木山顶最冷的夜晚预计约 -30 °C，新雪会又轻又干。
万龙、云顶、太舞、富龙和延庆国家高山滑雪中心整周的中间预报都是 0 厘米，即使最高预报也没有新雪。万龙、云顶、太舞和延庆山顶缆车处的夜间最低气温约 -15 °C，富龙约 -13 °C。
对滑雪者来说，这一周并不坏。干冷的夜晚正是造雪需要的条件，崇礼的大型雪场可以靠人造雪开放更多雪道。只是在十二月之前，别指望这里有粉雪。

sections.h: 吉林和黑龙江：亚布力有一点雪
p: 在东北，亚布力阳光滑雪度假区是名单上唯一有真正降雪机会的雪场：约 4 厘米，范围 0 到 7 厘米。长白山可能下约 1 厘米。吉林市附近的北大湖和松花湖在中间预报中保持干燥，最高预报中北大湖也最多只有 1 厘米。北大湖山顶最冷的夜晚约 -18 °C，亚布力阳光约 -16 °C。

sections.h: 两个地区为什么差别这么大
p: 新疆北部和中国东北纬度相同，天气却完全不同。阿尔泰山和天山迎着穿越中亚的湿润西风，深秋时这股气流常给山区带来小雪，随后的严寒又把雪留住。东北则处在干燥的冬季风之下：冷空气从蒙古和西伯利亚南下，连续多日晴空万里，真正的降雪需要来自南方或海上的气旋。
所以崇礼可以非常冷却依然没有雪，这也是那里的雪场在造雪上投入巨大的原因。同样，一场气旋就能让那里的雪况迅速改变：一旦有降雪过程，值得关注雪况地图。
如果想在十二月初滑天然雪，阿勒泰是稳妥的选择：禾木和可可托海已经拥有全国最厚的雪底，这一周还会继续增加。如果在北京附近滑雪，请以压好的人造雪道为主，挑一个寒冷的工作日出发，避开排队。我们会每天在地图上跟踪雪况，并用英文和中文发布新文章。

advice: 阿勒泰（禾木、可可托海、将军山）：十二月初滑天然雪的最佳选择。
崇礼和延庆：这一周干燥，以人造雪为主；出发前查看开放的雪道。
山顶约 -30 °C 时冻伤来得很快：护好脸部，适时到室内休息。
一周后的预报仍可能变化：出发前一晚再查看一次。
